acquisition_method: evidence: Full MS scan over the mass-to-charge (m/z) range of 300–1750 with a resolution of 120,000, followed by data dependent acquisition with an isolation window of 2.0 m/z and a dynamic exclusion time of 30 s was performed.
alkylation_concentration: evidence: Proteins were alkylated by addition of 100 μL IAA solution (0.05 M iodoacetamide in UA buffer) and incubated for 30 min at room temperature, followed by centrifugation.
alkylation_reagent: evidence: Proteins were alkylated by addition of 100 μL IAA solution (0.05 M iodoacetamide in UA buffer) and incubated for 30 min at room temperature, followed by centrifugation.
cleavage_agent: evidence: Filter units were transferred to new collection tubes and proteins were resuspended in 40 µL DB with Trypsin/Lys-C mix (Promega, Madison, WI, USA) for overnight proteolytic digestion at 37°C.
collision_energy: evidence: The top 12 ions were fragmented by higher energy collisional dissociation (HCD) with a normalized collision energy of 27% and scanned over the m/z range of 200–2000 with a resolution of 15,000.
enrichment_method: evidence: We demonstrate that density-based fractionation of urine by bottom-up Optiprep density gradient centrifugation separates EV and soluble proteins with high specificity and repeatability.
fractionation_method: evidence: We demonstrate that density-based fractionation of urine by bottom-up Optiprep density gradient centrifugation separates EV and soluble proteins with high specificity and repeatability.
